final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), all_patients AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN all_patients AS a WHERE p.ratio > a.avg_ratio
